g.text: Each distribution: 2,158 ECGs × six fixed noise bases; seven conditions kept separate.
Thin lines: 5th–95th percentiles; thick: IQR; marker: median (not confidence intervals). Nonfinite SNR values excluded from drawing only: 0; all retained in tables.
